content.short: Erasure is a transparency and information protocol.
content.description: Erasure uses the NMR token to power a staking-based, on-chain protocol that enables two strangers to exchange information with trust. It helps users obtain honest answers and feedback for selected puzzles or requests. Buyers can place funds in escrow and release them only when the seller’s answer is satisfactory. Developers can integrate Erasure’s endpoints into their own projects. The protocol emphasizes trustless interaction and verifiable outcomes, aligning incentives toward quality responses. Erasure offers three products: Numerai, Numerai Signals, and Erasure Bay.
